newsitem.title: USA: CME board elects vice chairman, other officers.
newsitem.headline: CME board elects vice chairman, other officers.

text.p: The Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) on Wednesday said its board of directors elected its top officers for 1997.
Scott Gordon, executive vice president of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Futures (USA) Inc, was re-elected vice chairman for a third straight term, CME said in a statement.
Joel Greenberg, chairman of Incomnet and a director of Alaron Trading, was newly elected to the post of second vice chairman.

All CME board officers serve a one-year term except the chairman, who serves two years. The board had re-elected chairman Jack Sandner to the top post last year. He is now serving his 13th year as the leader of the exchange after being re-elected to the board earlier in the month.

CME added that Joel Stender, president of the J Stender Investment Co and president of Newco Inc, will serve as the board's secretary, and Thomas Kloet, chief operating officer and chief financial officer of Credit Agricole Futures Inc, will serve as treasurer.
